summary: Endeavour Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K with a Material Change Report dated August 18, 2026, disclosing a temporary suspension of operations at its Terronera mine in Jalisco, Mexico, since August 12, 2026, due to an illegal blockade by Ejido community members. The blockade concerns road maintenance, medical services, water access, and financial assistance. The site remains staffed with reduced workforce, and discussions are ongoing. The company may pursue legal remedies if prolonged. This is an operational disruption, not a corporate special situation transaction.
